reason: Both correctly identify the LEFT JOIN/WHERE bug, the UTC/local timezone mismatch, integer division truncation, and NULL total_spent for zero-order customers, but B also catches two additional real defects A misses: NULLs sorting as the largest value under ORDER BY ...
